resources.string: DigitalBalance needs Usage Access to calculate how long you use each app and show your daily total.
Your usage data is read and processed only on this phone. It is not uploaded or backed up.
Usage Access is Special App Access managed in Android Settings, not a normal permission pop-up. You stay in control and can turn it off at any time.
Android has not reported foreground app activity for today. Use a few apps, then return and refresh.
Something prevented DigitalBalance from reading today’s usage.
User-facing apps only; home screen and background components are excluded
